full_prompt_en: A square detailed landscape painting shows a narrow gray road running toward a dark brick arch beneath a densely wooded hillside. The view is slightly elevated and faces into the rising terrain, so the road begins near the lower center and descends visually into the small black opening at the base of a warm red brick wall. A thin pale line marks each side of the roadway. The wall crosses the middle ground from left toward right, stepping with the slope. A small pale arched inset appears on its left portion, and orange-red brick texture remains visible across the surface. Large clipped shrubs and irregular rocks surround the arch, making its dark center more emphatic. At lower left, a broad yellow-green bank catches light, punctuated by deep olive patches and a few compact bushes. On the right, dark green rock and rounded masses rise close to the path, with pale spiky growth tucked into their creases. Beyond the wall, an extraordinary array of trees fills the upper half. Their canopies are sculpted into layered domes and broad umbrellas in olive, sage, yellow-green, charcoal, and pale blue-gray. Distinct pale trunks and delicate branch forks show beneath some crowns. A tall pale blue conical tree stands at left of center, while a gold-green rounded crown towers at the top center. Patches of light hillside and glimpses of red brick building appear between the trunks on the right. The sky is only a thin strip of cloudy off-white at the top. The paint has the fine, densely worked surface of an illustrative landscape, with stippled foliage, small repeating leaf marks, precise brick courses, and clear contour boundaries. Daylight is soft but directional, lighting selected crowns and the left slope while leaving the tunnel and clustered understory nearly black. The road supplies a calm center line through exuberant, patterned growth, making the compact scene feel both carefully tended and quietly mysterious.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形细密风景画呈现一条窄灰路，通向树木繁密山坡下的深暗砖拱洞。视点略高，朝逐渐升起的地形望去，因此道路从下方中央开始，在视觉上进入暖红砖墙底部的小黑开口。道路两边各有一条细浅线。砖墙从左向右横过中景，并顺着坡度形成高低。一处小浅色拱形嵌口位于墙的左段，橙红砖纹仍能看见。大块修剪过的灌木与不规则石头围住拱洞，使中央黑暗更醒目。左下宽阔黄绿坡面受光，上面散着深橄榄色斑块和一些紧凑矮灌。右侧深绿岩石与圆润大块紧贴道路升起，浅色尖叶生长物藏在它们的裂隙里。墙后，上半幅填满种类繁多的树。树冠被塑成层叠圆顶与宽伞形，颜色是橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、黄绿、炭黑和浅蓝灰。部分树冠下露出明确的浅色树干与纤细分枝。中心偏左立着一棵浅蓝色锥形树，画面顶端中央则有高大的金绿色圆冠。右侧树干之间露出受光的山坡和红砖建筑一角。天空只在最上方留下细窄灰白云带。颜料表面像细密加工过的插画风景，叶丛有点彩、小重复叶形笔迹、准确砖缝和清楚轮廓边界。日光柔和但有方向，照亮部分树冠与左坡，让隧道与密集下层植物近乎黑色。道路为繁茂、纹样化的生长物提供安静中线，让这幅紧凑景象既像精心养护，又带一点宁静的神秘感。
style_prompt_en: Detailed illustrative painting builds a dense patterned field from small repeated marks, stippled clusters, and sharply differentiated rounded forms. Olive, sage, mustard green, pale blue-gray, and occasional warm rust are arranged in adjacent textured areas rather than blended into one smooth wash. Clear contours make overlapping layers legible, while dark recesses and narrow light routes establish strong spatial depth. Fine linear details sit within larger controlled silhouettes, and pale planes receive softly directional daylight against heavier charcoal masses. The surface has an illustrative precision, with almost tapestry-like density and little empty space. A narrow central opening or receding line gives the eye a path through the intricacy, balancing controlled order with abundant irregular texture.
style_prompt_zh: 细密插画式绘画用重复小笔迹、点彩簇与区分清楚的圆润形体织成浓密纹样区域。橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、芥绿、浅蓝灰和偶尔的暖锈色彼此相邻成块，各有纹理，而非混为光滑水洗。明确轮廓使叠压层次可读，暗凹处与窄亮通道则建立强烈空间纵深。细线细节嵌在较大的受控剪影中，浅色平面受柔和定向日光照亮，与较重的炭黑块面对照。表面带插画式精确度，密度近似织毯，空白很少。一条窄中央开口或后退线让视线穿过繁密细节，使受控秩序与丰盛不规则肌理保持平衡。
theme_en: A narrow road passing beneath a brick arch in a densely wooded landscape
theme_zh: 窄路穿过树木繁密山景中的一座砖拱门
name: Simon Palmer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
